---
applyTo: '**'
---
project context:
- NixOS configuration for Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL)
coding guidelines:
- Use declarative configuration for system settings.S
- Keep configurations in version control.
- Document changes and rationale in commit messages.
- Follow NixOS best practices for package management and system updates.
- Ensure reproducibility of the environment.
- Test configurations in a safe environment before applying to production systems.
- Use meaningful names for configuration files and modules.
- Avoid hardcoding values; use variables and parameters where possible.
- Regularly update and maintain the configuration to keep up with NixOS updates.
